concept.title: Advanced Workflows
concept.shortdesc: Less-common Git features the Git Client supports: stashes, submodules, worktrees, and large files.

conbody.p: Once you're comfortable with the everyday workflow, the Git Client also handles:

ul.li: — shelve changes to switch context without committing.
— multiple working copies of one repository.
— binary and large files tracked with Git LFS.
